rationale: The Latin anchors *surgere*, *ascendere*, and *descendere* all denote physical movement upward or downward (e.g., "ascende cacumen Phasgæ montis" = "ascend the peak of Mount Pisgah"), and the OE *a-stígan* means to go up/down (climb, ascend, descend). The best-fitting synset is travel.v.01 ("change location; move, travel, or proceed"), which captures the core sense of physical locomotion/movement, as the more directional "ascend/descend" senses are not available among candidates and this is the closest literal movement sense.
